_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Wena Mdlali {player_id} kwa Tic Tac Toe.
Inkhululeko yakho kukheta kuti ushaye maphakathi matatu kwenye ushaya (ngokwezihlangu, ngokwesibhamu, noma ngokwezidonsa).
Ebusuku bakho, wena ufuna kuchagua inombolo yesigaba (0-8) usafuna kuyiphakela khona isithombe sakho esikhulwini.
Njengemifano, '[4]' ikheta isithombe sakho esikhundleni sesitinganekwane sesibhakabhaka.
NjengoMdlali {player_id}, wena uza kuwa '{symbol}', wena umdlali wakho uzaba '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: The submitted move does not follow the correct format.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} akusiyo inombolo levumelekile. Kumele ibe emkhatsini wa 0 na 8.
